problems: sentence 3: says 'proves' but no cited fact does

sentences.text: In cell lines and neurons, a tagged 20-repeat arginine-rich peptide was rapidly internalized and transported to the nucleolus, a process mediated by temperature-dependent fluid-phase endocytosis.

Using iridium-labeled dipeptide repeat proteins and RNA interference screens, researchers identified CSPG4 as a candidate surface protein, noting that inhibiting glycosaminoglycan synthesis or reducing CSPG4 levels decreased peptide uptake.

Lowering CSPG4 expression shielded neurons from the toxic effects of the 20-repeat peptide, while a dual reporter system demonstrated that a 50-repeat peptide produced by one neuron readily spread to adjacent cells in vitro.

Fluid from neurons expressing 50-repeat arginine or glycine peptides contained transmissible protein that entered other neurons in a CSPG4-dependent manner, suggesting CSPG4 facilitates the cellular uptake and intercellular transfer of these arginine-rich peptides.
